meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一次深入调研变成带引用、经审核的完整报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 要做一次深入调研并产出可引用的结论报告
copy.tagline_en: Turn a deep investigation into a cited, reviewed report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a thorough investigation with a cited, verified deliverable

howto.what: 启用后 Claude 进入研究编排模式:自己拆分课题与假设、组建协作团队分头铺开资料、逐条追线索并用辩论互相攻击,对有争议的说法跑代码验证,最后交出一份每条结论都带引用或验证证明的综合报告,回复开头打印「ULW-RESEARCH MODE ENABLED!」。
howto.when: 仅当用户明确要求研究、深度调研或超精确调查时触发;出现「ulw-research」、「ulw」等 ulw 研究措辞或 ultradebate、hyperdebate 请求也触发。普通提问、调试或别处的背景收集不算,按常规回答并提示该技能可用。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 调研这个主题,每条结论都要有引用
say.note: 先进入研究模式,再按流程拆分课题、组队收集

say.text: 对这个问题做超精确调查,有争议的结论跑代码验证
say.note: 争议说法会进入辩论轮并被实际执行验证

say.text: 用 ulw-research 研究 X,最终交付 PDF 和 DOCX
say.note: 开跑前会先问你想要的交付格式和模板

howto.what_en: Claude scopes the topic, stands up a cooperating research team, fans out over sources, cross-debates contested claims, proves them by running code, and delivers a synthesis where every claim carries a citation or proof.
howto.when_en: Triggers only on an explicit request for research, deep research or ultra-precise investigation, or 'ulw-research' / 'ulw' wording / an ultradebate request; ordinary questions and debugging do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Run ulw-research on this topic; every claim must carry a citation
say_en.note: Enters research mode, then briefs and builds the team

say_en.text: Do an ultra-precise investigation; prove contested claims by running code
say_en.note: Contested claims go through debate rounds and executed proofs

say_en.text: Use ulw-research on X and deliver it as PDF and DOCX
say_en.note: It first asks which output format and template you want
